title: The WWII Balloon Bombs That Reached America
topic: WWII Japanese balloon bombs that reached America
format_note: User-specified ~35 s historical Short (119 words, 36.9 s, fast narrator). Overrides the 50-60 s explainer targets on purpose. The chandelier, sandbags and bomb are drawn larger than scale so they read on a phone.
mechanism: Paper balloons launched from Japanese beaches rode the winter jet stream 6,000 miles to North America, an altimeter dropping sandbags to keep them up; the US hid them from the press and traced their sand, and one killed six picnickers in Oregon.

beats.hook: A bomb on a paper balloon swings at the lens over the clouds; crew let one go on a dawn beach; it races the jet stream; it smashes into an American pine top
beats.story: Schoolgirls paste the paper; soldiers fill it with hydrogen and let it go
beats.rise: It crosses the ocean by itself, dropping sandbags, and lands in Alaska, Montana, Michigan
beats.twist: A church picnic in an Oregon forest walks up to one hanging in a pine (white flash, silence)
beats.mechanism: Altimeter box and sandbag ring, newsroom DO NOT PRINT stamp, geologist's microscope on the ballast sand
beats.ending: The monument in the pines, then an old balloon half-buried in the needles; loops back to the bomb over the clouds

seed.what: The paper balloon with its bomb and sandbag ring
